subject: CYCLE-1 CORRECTION: exact Beta2 APK already attempted INNER physical+logical wake; discriminate route absence vs OEM policy vs presentation
body: Correction/refinement to this chat's earlier base-source finding: checked-in DuoShellService at 1cf46d/current main is physical-only, but the exact tested Beta2 APK was produced with tools/apply_gen7_runtime_regression_beta2.py and its CI-applied source extends WAKE_INNER_DISPLAY beyond physical NORMAL. Exact Beta2 path resolves the INNER physical panel, searches an include-disabled 1968x2184 logical route mapped to that physical ID, enables it, re-resolves/revalidates it, and requests logical Display.STATE_ON. The transformed coordinator retries up to 5 times at 55 ms and logs innerActive/innerDefault plus shell innerLogicalId/innerLogicalPowered/usefulReady/logicalError. Therefore 'missing logical activation' is NOT a sufficient explanation for the user's Beta2 50-60deg dark delay. However no fresh Beta2 field diagnostic archive is currently stored, so we do not know whether that field run found the route, whether enable/power succeeded, or whether Samsung subsequently withheld/remapped active/default/presentation authority. Next physical capture must classify three branches on one attempt: (A) innerLogicalId=-1/no route before OEM threshold -> Samsung route withheld; (B) shell logical power true but topology innerActive/default false -> OEM device-state/layout policy defeats/overrides forced route; (C) route/topology become active early but glass remains dark -> composition/presentation bottleneck. Preserve cover visual separately; do not treat shell usefulReady=physicalPowered&&logicalPowered as actual useful pixels. Also retain strict attempt/generation fencing because exact Beta2 has a confirmed stale-wake transaction-boundary defect. This correction supersedes only any implication that the tested Beta2 APK lacked logical-route activation; the physical-vs-logical-vs-presentation separation remains valid.
